item.title: From funeral flowers to bongs: Here's what NOT to get your partner this Valentine's Day
item.description: When it comes to finding the right Valentine's Day gift for your special someone, it's often the thought that counts. But it turns out that some people have really awful ideas.Look, Valentine's Day doesn't have to be complicated. A restaurant reservation, a nice bouquet of flowers, a box of chocolates, maybe a heartfelt card — these classics exist for a reason. They work. But every year, countless people decide to get creative or simply phone it in, and the results can be absolutely disastrous.
